process: Geographic Data and NSO Income Integration
income_indicator: รายได้ทั้งสิ้นต่อเดือน
join_type: many NSO socioeconomic groups to one geographic summary
limitations: Geographic risk data is at subdistrict/village record level and is aggregated to province-year level before integration.
NSO income data is provincial survey data separated by socioeconomic group, not individual household income.
Geographic risk summary is repeated for each socioeconomic group in the integrated contextual dataset.
This integration does not establish household-level relationships between income and flood risk.
